quotes.summary_phrase: De'Aaron Fox's performance and injury impact on the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: he's dealing with this high ankle sprain he's 26 for 76 since he came back from that injury
quotes.quote: De'Aaron Fox hasn't been very good. He's dealing with this high ankle sprain. He's 26 for 76 since he came back from that injury. He's five for 29 from three. He's taking nine free throws total in 195 minutes. He's a guy that's just not able to get into the paint like he usually can. He's an incredibly explosive player. But because of that, that leaves the Spurs a little short when he's not making shots. If he's not making shots, Dylan Harper can come in and give them the offense they need.
